_: Editorial for polo-nightshade. Fabric, fit, size guide, marquee, closing CTA and cross-sell come from _family-polo-classic.json.
_specs: The design name comes from the Shopify image filename, the only record of what the print is. Nothing about the artwork is invented.
buyBody: The same floral idea in black and white, with the contrast turned all the way up. The darkest thing in the Classic range.
pieceParas: Black ground, white linework, and no third color anywhere. Stripping the palette back to two turns a floral print into something closer to graphic design.
It is the one that reads as a pattern from across a fairway rather than as flowers, which is why it works on people who would never wear the Azalea.
lifestyleBrief: Portrait 4:5, on body. High-contrast print on a dark ground needs a bright background to separate — sky or open fairway, never trees. There is no on-body apparel photography at all yet (HANDOFF §7b F).
